name: current-weather
description: Current weather for any global location — temperature, feels-like, humidity, precipitation, wind, and a human-readable condition string, keyless via Open-Meteo, paid per call (~$0.001) over x402 via the SELAT Router.

location.description: City or location (e.g. London, New York, Tokyo) or lat/lon coordinates — used as ${location} in the request body. See references/endpoints.md for the accepted forms.

steps.label: current weather — weather.payapi.market (x402 via Circle Gateway)
